questions.q: What original meaning did the phrase "stay woke" have?
questions.why: The text says it was used by black people to stay alert to racism.

questions.q: How do corporations mainly benefit from donating to social causes?
questions.why: They profit more from public opinion than the cause itself.

questions.q: Which company held classes on "how to be less white"?
questions.why: The text cites Coca‑Cola as offering such classes.

questions.q: What did Airbnb do with user data when asked by the Chinese government?
questions.why: Airbnb gave the data to the Communist Party for profit.

questions.q: According to the book, what new external factor do corporations now prioritize besides shareholders?
questions.why: Stakeholders are now among the most important external influences.
